goals.objective: End-to-end attempt to promote source-derived Ichitaro 3x2 table layout from diagnostic evidence to renderable table projection when justified. Use the newly updated ichitaro-source-y-probe/new PAGE 01 baseline/down/right JTD+PDF samples. Implement the smallest Rust changes needed to derive X/Y table placement from source-only signals, keep diagnostic blockers if evidence is insufficient, and prove the outcome through failing-first tests plus CLI/PDF real-surface evidence. Do not use sample-name/reference-PDF hardcoding for production rendering; preserve decoded=false/source-backed safety labels unless the source transform is proven.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI/PDF auxiliary-surface happy path: run rjtd source-y-probe-compare across new PAGE 01 right_1..4 and down_1..4 plus a bundled-python pdfplumber coordinate sweep; PASS iff compare exposes right firstCellOffsetDelta=2/4/6/8 with down firstCellOffsetDelta=0, all nine table-candidates are 3x2 cells=6/0/6, and PDF deltas remain right X=5.28/10.56/15.96/21.24pt and down Y=16.80/33.60/50.40/67.08pt. Capture stdout to .omo/evidence/source-table-layout-promotion-20260705/c001-source-and-pdf-sweep.txt
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/evidence/source-table-layout-promotion-20260705/c001-source-and-pdf-sweep.txt | cleanup: no runtime process, tmux session, browser context, bound port, container, or temp dir spawned; CLI/pdfplumber commands exited

successCriteria.scenario: CLI/PDF render-admission edge proof: add/run a failing-first Rust or CLI assertion before production change, then run rjtd page-layer-tree/page-svg/pdf-output for PAGE 01 baseline/right/down; PASS iff any promoted tableProjection is source-only, not sample-name/reference-PDF backed, has source-derived layout present/renderable, and generated rjtd PDF/SVG table bbox/text positions match Ichitaro PDF within documented tolerance. If the source transform cannot be proven, PASS only as a blocked-safe outcome when artifact shows diagnosticProjection remains, admission stays ready=false, and blocker names the missing source-only transform. Capture to .omo/evidence/source-table-layout-promotion-20260705/c002-render-admission-or-blocker.txt
